note: The stone weighing hall seen from its forecourt: the same building as on the Place du Marché (giant brass balance on the roof ridge, blank plaque, green arched double door, two potted bay trees). Ground floor: entrance hall (adverbs of degree 1, zoom: weighing counter), quantities 1, quantities 2, quantities 3; first floor (stairs up from quantities 3): adverbs of degree 2, quantities 4, adverbs of degree 3 (zoom: display table). Inside walk: R_adv_degree_01 -> R_abs_quantity_01 -> R_abs_quantity_02 -> R_abs_quantity_03 -> (stairs up) R_adv_degree_02 -> R_abs_quantity_04 -> R_adv_degree_03.
